en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a river flowing through a narrow valley bordered by steep rocky cliffs on the right and dense conifer forest on both sides. A small path runs along the river at the base of the cliffs, and a few buildings are visible among the trees on the left foreground. The scene is mountainous and heavily wooded. Printed caption text appears in the lower margin.
